title: Magnetic eruptions in arrested accretion flows
description: Long-duration 3D simulations follow how accumulated magnetic flux disrupts black-hole accretion and produces non-axisymmetric eruptions, winds, and rapid variability.
result: The simulations showed that flux eruptions can transport angular momentum vertically and connect magnetic energy release to flaring signatures.

related_publications.title: Flux eruption events drive angular momentum transport in magnetically arrested accretion flows

title: Misaligned accretion and intermittent jets
description: Three-dimensional simulations test how black-hole spin, disk tilt, and magnetic flux compete to set the geometry and persistence of relativistic jets.
result: Strong magnetic fields can realign the inner flow, while highly tilted disks can collide with jets, expel horizon-threading flux, and interrupt outflow power.

related_publications.title: Misaligned magnetized accretion flows onto spinning black holes
Observational signatures of disc and jet misalignment

title: Jets from the horizon to galactic scales
description: Global simulations track acceleration, collimation, and instability as relativistic jets propagate through surrounding winds and ambient gas.
result: Jet–wind interaction naturally produces entrainment, a slower sheath, and limb-brightened or cylindrical structures seen in resolved radio jets.

related_publications.title: Accelerating AGN jets to parsec scales using GRMHD simulations
How to Turn Jets into Cylinders near Supermassive Black Holes

title: Giant magnetar bursts
description: Relativistic MHD simulations follow the response of a magnetar magnetosphere to sudden surface shear and magnetic twisting.
result: The modeled eruption launches a magnetically dominated plasmoid and hot trailing outflow while leaving a trapped fireball near the star.

related_publications.title: Relativistic Magnetohydrodynamic Simulations of Giant Magnetar Bursts

title: Accretion onto magnetized neutron stars
description: Ongoing 3D, non-radiative GRMHD calculations examine tilted disks, magnetically channelled accretion, surface hotspots, and collimated outflows around rotating neutron stars.
result: Current simulations show warped inner disks, structured accretion columns, and outflows whose power oscillates with the disk–magnetosphere interaction.

title: From global flows to particle acceleration
description: Current local MHD turbulence and current-sheet simulations use test particles to study how reconnection, shear, and turbulence inject and accelerate energetic particles.
result: The work connects local acceleration diagnostics to magnetic structures measured in global compact-object simulations.
